newsitems.contents: [p]Here's your confirmed intel on how to pre-load the Open Beta right now, and the Weekend Two content waiting when the [i]Call of Duty[/i] Open Beta begins this Friday.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f3ed1bc8b3cec670d4a28b25c18a180fe860ab7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Getting Started[/h2][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta Schedule[/h3][list][*][p]All players can preload the Open Beta starting at 9:00 AM PT on Wednesday August 26.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weekend Two (Open Beta): August 28 at 10:00 AM PT – September 1 at 10:00 AM PT[/p][/*][/list][p]The Open Beta begins at 10:00 AM PT, Friday August 28 for players on Steam. The Open Beta is scheduled to end at 10:00 AM PT on Tuesday, September 1. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s how to participate in the Open Beta:[/p][list][*][p]The Beta is available to all players. pre-order or Beta Codes are needed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]How to Access and Launch the Beta[/p][p]Steam (PC)[/p][list][*][p]Preload (Available Now): Beta to your Library and begin downloading.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Launch (Available at 10:00AM PT on Friday, August 28): Open your Steam Library and select [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] Beta when the Beta goes live.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta Rewards[/h3][p]Progress through the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta, rank up, and unlock cosmetic rewards along the way.[/p][list][*][p]Weekend Two: Start from Player Level 1, or return return to continue progressing from Weekend One, up to Level 30, unlocking all eight Beta Rewards, including the "Dread Tiger" Operator Skin for Reece, and the "Beta Forged" Weapon Blueprint for the Han 86 Assault Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][p]These rewards can only be earned during the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta and will be available in the full game at launch for players who unlock them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6c142460010825ef0043498d35704318789ae77.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Beta Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player Level 4: "Through the Paces" Legendary Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 8: "First Served" Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 12: "Meonjeo" Legendary Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 16: "Last Charge" Legendary Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 20: "Dread Tiger" Operator Skin – Reece[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 23: "Field Tested" Epic Spray[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 26: "Beta Rights" Epic Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 30: "Beta Forged" Weapon Blueprint – Han 86[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Additional Rewards[/b][/p][p]There's even more to unlock throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. Keep an eye out for additional cosmetic rewards earned through a variety of activities, including:[/p][list][*][p]Default Items (immediately available): 3 Emblems, 3 Calling Cards, 1 Spray, and 3 Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mobility Course Challenge Reward: Clockwork Charm.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Combat Record Rewards: \[CLASSIFIED] Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, and Charm.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward: \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta Twitch Drops[/p][p]These rewards are available for watching your favorite creator throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][list][*][p]"Get Tactical" Emblem (for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]"Clearing House" Calling Card (for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]"Action Ready" Charm (for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][p]For [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/managing-your-activision-profile"]further details on linking your Twitch account, click here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Patch Notes Access[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b] [i]Stay up to date throughout the Modern Warfare 4 Beta with the latest Patch Notes from the Infinity Ward Comms team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/07f9045a3dc6a3814608a244e94506de76e5164a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect updates throughout the Beta covering everything from bug fixes and gameplay adjustments to new maps and modes. Visit the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Patch Notes for the latest intel.[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4: Open Beta (Weekend Two) Content Intel[/h3][p]Everything below is available the Open Beta, giving you an early look at the Multiplayer, Campaign, and gameplay systems featured in the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. [/p][p]Looking for a deeper dive? Check out the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/08/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-open-beta-everything-you-need-to-know"]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Everything You Need to Know blog[/url], featuring comprehensive breakdowns of every map, mode, weapon, gameplay system, progression unlock, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]Campaign Mission: “Entrenched”[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b] [i]For the first time in a Call of Duty Beta, play a Campaign mission.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Join a large-scale assault to prevent the destruction of a vital nuclear power station.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Continue the fight with Campaign Early Access starting October 16 for digital pre-orders, ahead of the full game launch on October 23.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6b1a9f604122eba7271cfa581ec15c363c8210e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the first time in Call of Duty Beta history, deploy into a complete Campaign mission before launch. In “Entrenched,” fight alongside friendly infantry and armored vehicles as you battle to prevent a strategically vital nuclear power station from falling into enemy hands.[/p][p][/p][h3]Mobility Course[/h3][p]Flex your expertise in mobility and make your way through the course as fast as possible.[/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Enter a dedicated training facility built to teach Modern Warfare 4's expanded movement and combat systems.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Learn every new maneuver through guided Tutorials before putting your skills to the test in timed Courses.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Return throughout the Beta to improve your ratings, refine your movement, weapon handling, and marksmanship, and build confidence before your next Multiplayer match.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/acc6d9c14a577053a6fa768b35f2e31ff24a6713.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're a new recruit or a returning veteran, the Mobility Course is your proving ground for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]'s expanded movement and combat systems. Master new traversal techniques, sharpen your gunplay, chase faster completion times, and revisit the Courses whenever you want to fine-tune your skills between Multiplayer matches.[/p][p][/p][h3]Player Progression (Multiplayer)[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Earn XP in Multiplayer matches to increase your Player Level and unlock new gameplay content.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]Open Beta:[/i][/b][i] Progress from Levels 1-30, unlocking new weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and eight Beta Rewards.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Beta Rewards earned during the Open Beta carry over to the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1109307ef7f16d8f9602b8de3a2ef9b313b50108.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Multiplayer match brings you closer to your next player level and new unlock. Climb through the ranks to expand your arsenal, customize your loadouts, and unlock Create a Class at Level 4. Continue earning XP to complete your progression and unlock even more weapons, Equipment, Perks, and Beta Rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3]Create a Class and Operators[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Build up to 12 Custom Loadouts, each with its own Operator, Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrade, and Killstreaks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Operators are now assigned on a per-loadout basis, giving every Custom Loadout its own identity.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Choose from 21 Operators during the Beta, including military specialists, iconic characters, and additional Operators available with the Vault Edition.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Unlock Create a Class at Player Level 4 and expand your customization options as you progress.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da996c940de791da23e484ffbb40ce8802732c84.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] streamlines Create a Class by bringing every major loadout choice together into a single menu, making it faster than ever to build specialized loadouts for every combat role. Pair a unique Operator with each Custom Loadout, customize your weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrade, and Killstreaks, then fine-tune your setup before every deployment.[/p][p]Operators are now fully integrated into Create a Class, allowing each loadout to feature its own distinctive look, voice, and interchangeable Finishing Move. The Beta includes 21 Operators to choose from, including Operators available through the Vault Edition, with more arriving at launch.[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons, Gunsmith, Apex Attachments, Gunny, and Firing Range[/h3][p]QUICK INTEL:[/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy with 19 weapons spanning nine weapon classes, with three additional weapons becoming available through Campaign or Default Loadouts.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Customize your arsenal using the returning Gunsmith, then test every build in the Firing Range before deployment.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Unlock powerful Apex Attachments by fully leveling supported weapons, adding unique gameplay effects without using an attachment slot.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Need a starting point? Gunny can instantly recommend a wide variety of Weapon builds using Attachments you've already unlocked.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Weapons arrive with the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9aabf73dc4db41e5e23f41c096a7e0f973afdeb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Beta features 19 Multiplayer weapons spanning nine weapon classes. Three additional weapons are accessible through specific Default Loadouts or the Campaign mission, bringing the total number of weapons available across the Beta to 22. Customize supported weapons with Gunsmith, unlock game-changing Apex Attachments by mastering supported weapons, use Gunny to recommend optimized builds, and put every setup through its paces in the Firing Range.[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Looking for the complete arsenal? Check out the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta: Everything You Need to Know blog with the full Beta weapon roster, Gunsmith and Apex Attachment breakdowns, Gunny tips, and complete weapon intel.[/p][p][/p][h3]Equipment: Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Build every loadout with 9 Tactical Equipment items, 11 Lethals, and 11 Field Upgrades, including [b]new equipment in every category.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Gather intelligence, breach defended positions, deny enemy movement, defend objectives, and support your squad with equipment tailored to every combat role.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional equipment arrives with the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/797ecfefb65c96977aa10876dee37065b3635755.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every loadout is more than just your Primary and Secondary weapons. Choose Tactical Equipment to gather intel, disrupt enemy movement, or recover in the heat of battle; Lethal Equipment to clear defenders, deny routes, and secure eliminations; and rechargeable Field Upgrades to support your squad, defend objectives, and create new tactical opportunities. [/p][p][/p][h3]Killstreaks[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Equip up to three Killstreaks to every Custom Loadout before deploying into Multiplayer.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Earn Killstreaks by achieving consecutive eliminations without being eliminated.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]The Beta features 17 Killstreaks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Killstreaks arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381f5017db513dd78139b617122fdfe027332ef4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From reconnaissance and support to devastating offensive firepower, Killstreaks are powerful combat rewards earned through aggressive play and survival. Choose from new and returning Killstreaks to build your preferred combination for each Custom Loadout, then progress throughout the Beta to unlock additional options as the Player Level cap increases to 30.[/p][p][/p][h3]Perks[/h3][p]QUICK INTEL:[/p][list][*][p][i]Customize your Operator with the Pick 3 Perk System, equipping one Perk from each of three Perk slots.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Choose from 18 Perks during the Beta.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Mix and match Perks to support aggressive assaults, stealth, survivability, mobility, objective play, and tactical awareness.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Perks arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Perks are passive abilities that define how your Operator performs in combat. [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]'s Pick 3 system enables you to build combinations that complement your preferred weapons, Equipment, and overall playstyle, whether you're leading the charge, staying off enemy radar, or supporting your squad. [/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy into seven Core 6v6 Multiplayer modes during the Open Beta.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Play Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, Search and Destroy, Inflation (new mode), and Hijack (new mode).[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]From classic objective modes to tactical one-life competition, every mode supports full Create a Class functionality.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Multiplayer modes become available as the Beta continues, with more modes at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/231088053f7eca35c47b197b3b57a0db17d79a89.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Open Beta brings together Call of Duty's signature Multiplayer experiences with an all-new way to play. Alongside Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, and Search and Destroy, jump into Inflation, where every elimination builds your fortune while turning you into an increasingly valuable target. Also check out Hijack, where you carry, throw, or carry a Data Spike towards the enemy Comm Station, planting it to score while defenders race to defuse it. Each mode rewards a different style of play, from coordinated objective control to tactical, one-life precision.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Core 6v6 Maps[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Deploy across six Core 6v6 maps, each offering its own layout, engagement ranges, and tactical opportunities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fight across snow-covered rooftops, dense shopping districts, coastal villages, rail terminals, and an overgrown bus depot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Learn every route, flank, and vantage point before additional maps become available later in the Beta.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More Core Multiplayer maps arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Every [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta map delivers a distinct combat experience:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd334fc7bca39e62973404044733589e4e598a0a.jpg"][/img][b]Rooftops:[/b] Traverse the snow-covered rooftops of New York's Hotel Times West using elevated walkways and multiple routes to outmaneuver the opposition.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/006957529cb43b330c26b30ce0ace43aa129a551.jpg"][/img][b]Silkworm:[/b] Push through a dense South Korean shopping district where storefronts, alleyways, and apartments keep engagements fast and unpredictable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/990295c75b98a711ed9bbc49fb2986f4ab155fb5.jpg"][/img][b]Transit 213:[/b] Navigate an overgrown Indian bus depot divided by rusting buses, concealed routes, and long sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/711b2c4a159f65fc26d647e1ca26b16d3db24160.jpg"][/img][b]Cachette:[/b] Fight through a secret hideout next to a French rail terminal packed with shipping containers, rooftops, and compact interiors built for constant flanking.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e0f7934492e0d5c2468bb0087a3c21567df5da21.jpg"][/img][b]Lotus:[/b] Deploy into a battle-scarred Korean fishing village where narrow streets, burning buildings, and abandoned armor create varied engagements from close quarters to long sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f06439d7c40331b71e2a91cdf53f206a15288c8.jpg"][/img][b]Lithium:[/b] Fight across a damaged lithium processing facility in rural Mexico, where industrial buildings, processing equipment, interactive doors, and strong mid-range sightlines support a wide variety of combat styles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block and Gunfight[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Fight across Kill Block, a dynamic combat space that reconfigures every two rounds into a new Combo of three interconnected Slabs.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Experience Gunfight in both classic 3v3 and the 10v10 variant, exclusive to Kill Block.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Every map Combo introduces a new randomized shared Loadout, keeping every round fresh.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Eliminate the opposing team or capture the Overtime Flag to secure victory.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3035cf383c4720427652e9208ab867a45d808a5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Kill Block reimagines Gunfight with an ever-changing combat space built from interconnected Slabs. Every two rounds, a new Combo and randomized shared Loadout transform the flow of the match, demanding constant adaptation. Jump into the classic intensity of 3v3 Gunfight or the new 10v10 variant, where larger teams bring an entirely different dynamic—and considerably more mayhem—to Kill Block's evolving arenas.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War Multiplayer Maps (24v24, Beta)[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Battle across two large-scale Combat Outpost battlegrounds set within the Haijin region.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Fight between open countryside and dense urban terrain with infantry and vehicle combat across both maps.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Both maps offer unique routes, landmarks, and tactical opportunities.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Combat Outpost spans two distinct large-scale theaters of conflict, each offering a different approach to Ground War combat. Multi-story buildings, transit lines, tunnels, rooftops, and surrounding hillsides create a highly versatile arena of battle where every route offers multiple ways to advance.[/p][p][/p][h3]Call of Duty: Warzone Resurgence[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Experience Resurgence on the all-new Zodiac map.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Battle across the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly headquarters.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Stay alive while your teammates redeploy, then eliminate enemies and complete Contracts to shorten their return timer.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Outlast every opposing squad to secure the win.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1665ed163616d40761d6efa3a75821cfa3a74b04.jpg"][/img]Resurgence returns with the all-new Zodiac, a compact combat zone built around the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c53c46a7fec33520fea9b6d89f2692f528e349b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight from the company Admin building through and beneath the central double Trackline with multiple trains, then push toward the R&D facility and shipping docks as squads battle across offices, manufacturing buildings, rooftops, tunnels, and the surrounding shoreline. Expect an explosive tank battle, legendary loot, action across the ground and air, and other surprises to find during your matches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/748b7174fb26a06bab7d0f69e83162660af3ab9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Loadout has room to dominate and are default for the Beta. Choose from AR, SMG, LMG, or Sniper Default Loadouts. Close-range Operators can weave between buildings and through the center of the facility, while longer-range Loadouts benefit from rooftops and elevated windows overlooking the facility’s points of interest. Beneath it all, an underground tunnel network offers another way to rotate, flank enemy squads, or briefly disappear before launching your next attack.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay frosty: We'll see you in the Beta.[/p][p][/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026. [/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: The International Main Event
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. From Twitch to YouTube to Steam, The International will be streamed on multiple platforms in multiple languages.[/p][list][*][p][b]Chinese[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]English[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Russian[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Spanish[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Online Secret Shop[/h3][p]Fans interested in purchasing swag from this year's offerings are welcome to purchase online. We have two shops available, depending on which part of the world you're in. Fans located in China can purchase through [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] and fans everywhere else can head over to [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url] to check it all out.[/p]

newsitems.title: The International: Streams, Secret Shop, and More
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/aa83bcaaafe7cd4d11a841ec381ec28ccb039d41.png"][/img]It's the final countdown: Players and talent have landed, and all of the pieces are falling into place to make Shanghai the center of the Dota universe for the next two weeks. It's time to finish crafting your fantasy rosters, lock in your first round of predictions, and get ready to tune in because The International 2026 is almost underway.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to watch online, find Dota activities in Shanghai to keep you busy until streams start, or looking for merch you can wear while you're out in Shanghai waiting for games to start, we've got you covered below.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Group Stage[/h3][p]Sixteen teams have earned the right to compete for the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai, but only eight will face off in the main event. First, they must survive the gauntlet of the Swiss Format Group Stage.[/p][p][url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]Group Stage games begin[/url] on Thursday, August 13 and wrap on Sunday, August 16. In that span, all sixteen teams will play best-of-three matches against other teams with the same overall series record. A fourth series win will earn a team an automatic berth at The International; a fourth loss will result in elimination.[/p][p]By end of play on Saturday, three teams will have secured spots in The International and three teams will have been eliminated. The ten remaining teams will face off in a special elimination round to decide the rest. Every single one of the five series on Sunday will send one team home and the other onward to the main event.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Main Event[/h3][p]On Thursday, August 20, The International will move to SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center and open the doors to more than ten thousand fans. Four days of intense play through a double-elimination bracket will culminate in the Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23, and only then will the last team stand victorious and raise the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Tickets for the event are sold out, but there are tons of ways to watch online — and even a handful of special in-person opportunities available around the city of Shanghai.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tournament Streams[/h3][p]There's nothing quite like watching the best Dota players in the world face off in a live event, and while life and accompanying biological imperatives can make it difficult to try and watch every single game live, here are all the links you'd need to make a glorious attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]Chinese: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_4"]Stream D[/url]; newsitems.contents: In June 2020, Bungie made what would come to be remembered as one of the most reviled PR incidents in modern videogames: It announced the content vault. newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5179a724ee3987b0b0dab399b9ef2eaba7b2abf4.png[/img]

The International approaches and we've just released an update that includes [url=https://www.dota2.com/newsentry/678505520073540063]predictions, fantasy, supporter bundles[/url], and a chance to prove your skills and win new Immortals and unlock terrains.

But that's not all. Today we're also releasing [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]patch 7.41e[/url]. Even that's not everything, though. Dota is a complicated game, and while we greatly enjoy the creativity and diligence of the dedicated players who find intricate and absurd bugs, we also like *fixing* those bugs. So today we're also releasing the Summer Scrub, a huge collection of new features as well as fixes for gameplay and content bugs, ranging from Abaddon's taunt to Zeus's Dota Plus challenge.

The list is too long for this post, so we made a whole page just to [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]list all the changes[/url].

newsitems.title: Discussion time: Have you ever said goodbye to an MMO you've played for 1,000s of hours?
newsitems.author: Sean Martin
newsitems.contents: s someone who writes guides for a living, I'm always hopping between different games, riding the ever-rolling wave of live service updates, DLC, and new releases that define our industry. I've dipped my toes into all sorts of MMOs over the years, but amidst the constant barrage of games, only one ended up sticking around for me, and that was Destiny 2... Read more.

newsitems.title: Warframe creative director says Destiny 2's end is tragic, because even with hard work 'the business side of this industry always gets the last remark'
newsitems.author: Harvey Randall
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 isn't going anywhere, but it also isn't… well, going anywhere. The game's servers will still be running for the foreseeable future, but Bungie has since ceased updates to its flagship shooter to move onto other projects, tragically laying off much of its staff in the aftermath of that decision... Read more.

newsitems.title: Destiny 2 players get a final farewell gift from Bungie
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 is done: The final patch is out, Bungie is decimated, and the game will remain playable but the story of one of the biggest, best and most influential online shooters ever is over. To memorialize the moment, Bungie has rolled out one last gift for players: A new emblem, free for everyone, called Gloriabundus... Read more.
